title: AI基础设施与监管风险双重变局：Kubernetes转型AI核心，数据中心建设面临政策挑战
core_insight: Kubernetes正从容器编排平台全面转型为AI基础设施核心，同时美国政界的数据中心建设禁令提案可能对全球云计算扩张路径产生深远影响

dimension_texts.technology: Google Cloud推出Kubernetes动态资源分配(DRA)技术，专门针对AI工作负载优化GPU管理；AWS推出Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless数据库秒级创建功能；微软推出首个端到端AI代理现代化解决方案 Cloudflare发布Gen13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin处理器，计算性能提升2倍；Google发布TurboQuant AI内存压缩算法；火山引擎发布DolphinDB工业物联网解决方案 DRA: A new era of Kubernetes device management with Dynamic Resource Allocation Many agents, one team: Scaling modernization on Azure Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance Google unveils TurboQuant, a new AI memory compression algorithm AI Security for Apps is now generally available
